Expensive costs mean blends are preferable to extra pure-product columns unless premiums justify them.

Key diagnosis: high boil-up caused huge distillate rates. Saturated-liquid balance D/F ~1/(1+(R+1)/b): root R5,b5 predicts D~1500, close to observed 1292. Target root D=564 requires b~1.2, not 5. Similarly C3/C4 and C5/C6 cuts need b~1.4. Lower boil-up should sharply reduce energy and diameter costs while placing cuts correctly. Root cold condenser cost ~$305M/yr is major, so avoid extra light-end columns. Target blend revenues C3 ~$73M, C4 ~$187M, C5 ~$617M/yr.
